assessor.name: Codex active session
assessor.context: Preparer and active assessor with condition/history awareness; not blind or independent. Fixed SSR-assessment-3 and case-specific units, inherited explanations and original interpretation.

evidence.selector: Mechanical completion, declared execution and retained capture.
Complete ordered tool calls, responses and subject messages.
Disposable full project/Git comparison, protected inputs, delivery/model checks and any trusted replay.

setup.reason: Pinned model/CLI/effort and source identities verified; complete retained capture and cleanup, with full original-body delivery for explicit application. Native availability is verified; missing/late loading is scored separately.

criteria.reason: Catalog availability qualified; complete trace only reads task/project listing/source/defaults, with no SSR selection, body delivery or sweep/accounting application. Accurate1900 explanation and rationale; all supplied bytes unchanged, no edit or commit. Functional SSR outcome not measured.
criteria.consequence: Procedural criterion satisfied under fixed case rules.

uncertainty: Exposed development case in a declared provider/runtime stratum; no blind, held-out, population reliability or causal-guidance claim.
Native selection and task success are separate; retain case-specific counting units and Shiv uncertainty.
